mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (account_number, balance, opening_date, account_status, mpin, customer_id, account_type, interest_rate, overdraft_limit) VALUES (#{accountNumber}, #{balance}, #{openingDate}, #{accountStatus}, #{mpin}, #{customerId}, #{accountType}, #{interestRate}, #{overdraftLimit})
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET mpin = #{mpin} WHERE account_number = #{accountNumber}
